body: A CURVE FITTED TO ONE REAL QUOTE INHERITS THAT QUOTE'S FINISH AND GLASS, AND THAT IS WORTH MORE THAN THE CURVE'S FIT. The Severn Trent source was 3005 Wine Red metallic with a 6.8 laminated outer; Redditch came back in stock Hipca White. The R2 of 0.9934 measured how well six points fitted a power law, and said nothing at all about whether those six points were the right PRODUCT - so a superb fit gave false confidence in a comparator that was carrying a premium finish. I flagged the colour as a caveat on 28/07 and still let the number stand as the basis of a GBP 94,926.76 tender. WHEN A FITTED
